meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据简报灵活创作多场景视频作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit multi-scene video compositions from a brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to produce multi-scene videos or brand reels

howto.what: 安装后,Claude会按HyperFrames工作流处理视频合成:先更新技能并读取项目状态(BRIEF.md等),写出计划与分镜,加载媒体和动画规则,逐场景搭建并生成可渲染项目。在协作模式下,Claude会作为导演提出完整的上限方案。
howto.when: 当用户要求制作或编辑较长的多场景视频、品牌宣传片、混剪等,且没有专项技能适用时;或项目BRIEF.md设置了flow: companion时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 把这几段素材剪成一个30秒的品牌宣传片
按BRIEF.md的companion模式,和我一起设计这个蒙太奇
say.note: Claude会作为导演给完整方案。

say.text: 给这个多场景视频加一个静态开场标题卡
say.note: 加载对应规则生成标题卡。

howto.what_en: Claude authors or edits custom HyperFrames video compositions: updates the skill, reads project state, drafts plan/storyboard, loads media & animation rules, assembles scenes for rendering. In companion flow, it acts as director proposing a ceiling treatment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to create or edit longer multi-scene videos, brand/sizzle reels, montages, etc., and no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion.

say_en.text: Cut these clips into a 30-second brand reel.
say_en.note: Claude updates skill and starts planning.

say_en.text: In companion mode per BRIEF.md, co-design this montage with me.
say_en.note: Claude acts as director with a full treatment.

say_en.text: Add a static opening title card to this multi-scene video.
say_en.note: Loads relevant rules and generates the card.
